title: The Borrowed Badge
short_description: A badge log and an eyewitness point to the same employee. Check whether those sources really identify the person.
incident_report: A prototype was removed from the lab between 18:10 and 18:30. Alex maintains the lab, Blair handles deliveries, and Casey works at reception. Investigate the records before accusing anyone.

read_incident_report.observation: The prototype is missing. Alex, Blair and Casey were assigned to the building. The lab door is intact.

lab.observation: Alex's badge opened the lab at 18:22. No other badge opened it during the window.

evidence.description: Alex's badge serial A17 opened the lab at 18:22.

lab.observation: A face-obscured courier enters the lab with a crate at 18:22. The courier wears an orange sleeve with a triangular repair. Blair's delivery check-in at 18:10 records that same repair on their jacket.

evidence.description: Blair's check-in jacket and the face-obscured lab courier's jacket have the same triangular sleeve repair.

lab.observation: The prototype mount is empty and unbroken. A buyer's signed offer for the prototype is in the discarded delivery packing; it is addressed to Blair.

evidence.description: The prototype mount is empty, with no breakage or replacement object.
A signed offer to pay Blair for the prototype was discarded with delivery packing.

badge_reader.observation: The reader records physical badge serial A17. The equipment-desk camera shows Blair taking A17 from Alex's unattended coat at 18:12 and returning it at 18:28.

evidence.description: Badge A17 was taken from Alex's coat by Blair at 18:12, used in the lab at 18:22, and returned by Blair at 18:28.

delivery_crate.observation: A sealed crate in Blair's delivery trolley contains the missing prototype, matching the mount's serial number. A collection receipt signed Blair is timed 18:22.

evidence.description: The prototype's matching serial is inside Blair's sealed delivery crate; Blair signed its collection receipt at 18:22.

alex.observation: Alex says: 'I was in a live equipment demonstration all through the incident window. My coat was unattended.'

evidence.description: Alex claims to have remained in a live demonstration.

blair.observation: Blair says: 'I did not enter the lab. The crate was empty when I collected it.'

evidence.description: Blair denies entering the lab and says the collected crate was empty.

casey.observation: Casey says: 'I thought I saw Alex at the door because the badge display said Alex. I could not see the person's face.'

evidence.description: Casey's identification of Alex came only from the badge display, not a visible face.

alex.observation: Independent live demonstration recording places Alex in the auditorium continuously from 18:05 to 18:35.

evidence.description: Alex is visible in the live demonstration continuously from 18:05 to 18:35.

blair.observation: The loading-bay camera shows Blair returning with the sealed crate at 18:25.

evidence.description: Blair returns to the loading bay with the crate at 18:25.

casey.observation: Reception video places Casey at the desk continuously during the window.

evidence.description: Casey remains at reception throughout the incident window.

alex|casey.observation: Casey confirms their identification relied only on the badge display; Alex says the coat holding that badge was unattended.

evidence.description: Casey's identification supplies no facial observation independent of the badge display.
